event: 2026 ILCA 6 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: ITA 227819 was represented by Claudio CROCCO
HKG 220790 was represented by Charalampos VELIANITIS
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 14 knots of wind and choppy.
On leg 3 of race 8, ITA 227819 and HKG 220790 were sailing downwind both on port tack and surfing the waves.
ITA 227819 was overlapped to leeward of HKG 220790 with a initially lateral distance of 25m.
HKG 220790 bore down towards ITA 227819 while ITA 227819 held her course.
HKG 220790’s mainsheet caught the neck of the competitor of ITA 227819, causing her to capsized.
ITA 227819 recovered after 40 seconds, continued sailing and finished the race in 17th position.
HKG 220790 took a two turns penalty.
There was light redness on the neck of competitor of ITA 227819.
There was no injury or damage.
conclusions: HKG 220790 to windward failed to keep clear of ITA 227819 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
HKG 220790 did not avoid contact with ITA 227819 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for ITA 227819, the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with HKG 220790 when it became clear that HKG 220790 was not keeping clear. ITA 227819 did not break RRS 14(a).
Since RRS 44.1(b) did not apply, HKG 220790 took an applicable penalty by taking a Two-Turns Penalty and she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
ITA 227819’s place in race 8 was not made significantly worse. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
decision: The protest is upheld, no further penalty to HKG 220790.
Redress is not given to ITA 227819.
